aggregate_replay.returned_zero_interpretation: No marker component detector ran: all three specs were unconfigured and the production _components guard short-circuited. Physical marker absence was not measured.

diagnostic_improvement_proposal.meaning: No valid self detector means unavailable/not_evaluated; when a valid configured detector ran, report its zero, one, or multiple candidate outcome separately. Retain map_marker_missing and map_location_unresolved for compatibility.

profile_inventory.example_profile: config/visual_runtime.example.json has validated=false and minimap_colors_hsv={}; its note says empty data deliberately yields unknown and requires representative actual recordings before validation.
profile_inventory.interpretation: The pixel component capability exists, but no real-client marker asset was available for the runner to load. The default/example intentionally abstains; the test fixtures are not production profiles.
nonempty_repository_hits: tests/unit/test_visual_pixels_v2.py uses a synthetic green component to exercise the extractor.
tests/integration/test_map_zone_v3.py draws a synthetic magenta pixel onto the Summit reference and uses a validated fixture profile to exercise registration and resolution.

role_grounding_experiment.adoption_gate: Require evidence that distinguishes the current controlled-player symbol from these nonself controls and preserves absent/occluded/ambiguous rejection. Do not infer a self role from color, geometric calibration, or downstream location outputs.
role_grounding_experiment.counterexamples_to_guard: Teammate portrait rings can look like local-player rings; ping/spike/camera symbols may be angular or brightly colored; map labels and borders create compact components; multiple marker families coexist in the reviewed minimap crops.
role_grounding_experiment.input_requirement: Obtain current-build full-screen/minimap captures with the controlled-player symbol independently identified from UI appearance, plus hard negatives showing ally portraits and markers, enemy markers, spike/ping/ability indicators, map labels, absent, occluded, and ambiguous cases.
role_grounding_experiment.pixel_cues_to_evaluate_without_adopting: Shape/contour, interior portrait texture versus hollow fill, ring thickness, angular wedge/cone presence, orientation, edge support, and local color as a supporting feature only. These are candidate descriptors, not assumed self semantics.
role_grounding_experiment.protocol: Freeze appearance categories before scores; preserve full-frame context and minimap crop; use a disjoint recording/client-build holdout; retain unknown when multiple symbols fit or the controlled-player role is not visually identifiable.

scope: Aggregate-only replay of the nine calibration-accepted cases from one fixed replay. No frame-level IDs, times, images, locations, GT, or private paths are included.

source_explanation.client_build: calibration.py appends client_build_unverified to diagnostic output when the build is absent/unrecognized. It is not an acceptance failure in _profile_failure; the accepted geometric calibrations still return ok.
source_explanation.diagnostic_collapse: map_pipeline.py currently calls the result map_marker_missing whenever self_x_norm is null. It cannot distinguish no configured detector from a configured detector that ran and found zero components.
source_explanation.location_dependency: The resolver receives a controlled-player point only when calibration is accepted, ownership is safe, and a self minimap coordinate exists. No coordinate or zone can be resolved from calibration alone.
source_explanation.marker_extraction: pixels.py _components returns [] when a color spec is empty or lacks lower/upper. The minimap loop calls it per side from minimap_colors_hsv.
source_explanation.profile_path: settings.py defaults visual_profile_path to empty; run_real_video.py leaves it empty when optional --visual-profile is omitted; load_visual_profile returns {} for a blank path; bootstrap adds manual map selection and minimap ROI, but no marker specs.
